rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a toy kite.

example.english: We flew a kite at the beach today; the wind was strong.
example.traditional: 我哋今日去沙灘放風箏，風好大。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 heoi3 saa1 taan1 fong3 fung1 zang1 fung1 hou2 daai6

rows.note: A speaker uses this as a traditional written alternative to the everyday word 風箏.

example.english: Children in the past often flew a kite in the countryside.
example.traditional: 以前啲小朋友成日喺郊外放紙鷂。
example.jyutping: ji5 cin4 di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 seng4 jat6 hai2 gaau1 ngoi6 fong3 zi2 jiu6
